Ilse, I found three Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers. None are in #north-team itself.

- **QF-77031**: Sev 1 incident room (#inc-qfl-sev1). Dana posted it on 2026-10-14 as the postmortem ticket for the 4 Nov 2025 Superior outage. It holds the webhook listener root cause.
- **#PD-4492**: Moss's Sunday prep digest for Ruth, 2025-10-05 (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell raised it on 4 Oct 2025 about kiosk SMS bay assignments not reaching drivers at the Eau Claire yard. Support patched it and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
- **#4419**: Moss's undated North cheat sheet (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it for gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14. The cheat sheet says it was escalated to tier-2 for scanner firmware testing.

Two caveats:
- I can't see Moss's personal notes folder, so I only checked the North team digests Moss publishes.
- I can't look up tickets in the support system, so these numbers are as written in the chat and notes, not verified there. Also, #4419 and #PD-4492 look like different issues, so please check them before presenting them as one account history.
